summary: Blocker — reviewed commit 852bcda claims role-mutation and default-Section grant fixes but changes only four .outbox/runtime files; no product-code fix is present. src/services/binderService.js:135-144 and src/daos/binderDAO.js:193-202 still update roles without atomically locking/re-reading actor and target or enforcing actor.role < target.role, violating an explicit AC. Major — src/services/sectionService.js:112-120 still allows connectGroup on is_default Sections, contrary to the default-Section invariant cited by the commit. Major — groupService does not wrap GroupDAO.getMembers, so the required service surface is incomplete. No focused tests for the new group/Section ACL behavior were found.
verification: git show --name-status confirmed the reviewed commit contains only prior reviewer runtime artifacts.
All packet-required node --check commands passed for groupRoutes, groupService, groupDAO, sectionRoutes, sectionService, and sectionDAO.
Additional node --check passed for syncService, syncDAO, binderService, and binderDAO.
Repository search found no focused group/section-group ACL tests.
